unit: Unit 3 ~ Unit 4 比较级最高级专题
topic: 形容词与副词的比较级、最高级
summary: 两者比较用比较级（-er / more），三者及以上用最高级（-est / most）。

rules.title: 比较级、最高级的构成
rules.detail: 单音节词：加 er/est（tall → taller → tallest）；以 e 结尾加 r/st（nice → nicer → nicest）；重读闭音节双写（big → bigger → biggest，hot → hotter）；辅音+y 变 i 加 er/est（easy → easier → easiest）。多音节词：more/most + 原级（more beautiful，most beautiful）。

examples.en: Tom is taller than his brother.
This street is much busier than that one.
examples.zh: 这条街比那条街繁忙得多。

examples.en: English is the most interesting subject.

rules.title: 比较级句型：A + be/动词 + 比较级 + than + B
rules.detail: than 后比较的对象要一致。much / even / a little 可以修饰比较级（加强程度），但 very 不能修饰比较级！

examples.en: This room is much bigger than that one.
examples.zh: 这个房间比那个大得多。

rules.title: 最高级句型：the + 最高级 + 比较范围（in/of）
rules.detail: in 后接范围（in our class）；of 后接同类事物（of all the subjects）。

examples.en: Li Lei is the tallest in our class.
Spring is the best season of the year.
examples.zh: 春天是一年中最好的季节。

signals: one of the + 最高级 + 复数
pitfalls: very 修饰比较级：❌ much very better → ✓ much better（very 不能修饰比较级）
比较对象不一致：❌ The weather in Beijing is colder than Guangzhou. → ✓ ... colder than that in Guangzhou.
最高级漏 the：❌ He is tallest in our class. → ✓ He is the tallest in our class.

questions.stem: The Yangtze River is ___ than any other river in China.
questions.explain: than 提示用比较级 longer。

questions.stem: Li Ming is one of ___ students in our class.
questions.explain: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词：最好的学生之一。

questions.stem: The box is ___ heavier than I thought.
questions.explain: much/even 可修饰比较级，very 不能。
两者比较（Tom or Jim）用比较级 faster。

questions.stem: Winter is the ___ (cold) season of the year.
questions.explain: of the year 给出比较范围，用最高级 coldest。

questions.stem: This story is ___ (interesting) than that one.
questions.explain: interesting 是多音节词，比较级用 more interesting。

questions.stem: My room is more bigger than yours.
questions.explain: bigger 已是比较级，不能用 more 修饰；加强程度用 much bigger。

questions.stem: 她比我更擅长游泳。（翻译整句）
answer: she is better at swimming than me.
she is better at swimming than i am.
she is better at swimming than i.
questions.explain: be good at 的比较级是 be better at；than me 口语常用。

questions.stem: 语文和数学哪个更重要？（翻译整句）
answer: which is more important, chinese or math?
which subject is more important, chinese or math?
questions.explain: 两者比较用 more important；which 引出选择疑问。
